notes: *at the end of three years*: the *of* is the chain's own relation and goes to the rectum phrase, placed on the numeral it stands before (rule 19).
*the sixth year* and *was the ninth year*: שְׁנַת is construct with no article morpheme, so the supplied *the* joins the noun (rules 15, 29) and the copula joins the predicate (rule 20).
